evidence.title: unDraw CN - shadcn Registry for unDraw Illustrations

name: unDraw CN
summary: shadcn registry of all 1,362 unDraw illustrations as customizable, typed React components.
description: A shadcn registry that turns every unDraw illustration into a React component with TypeScript types. One CLI command installs an illustration; the components use your CSS --color-primary variable, are reactive to theme changes, and live in your own codebase with no CDN dependency.
contains: 1,362 illustration components covering all unDraw scenes
installs with the shadcn CLI (registry add)
TypeScript support, responsive SVGs with titles
